description:
During the end step of the opponent to your right, cast Kaervek's Spite by paying {B}{B}{B}, sacrificing all permanents you control, and discarding your hand, causing any target player to lose 5 life.
Oblivion Ring leaves the battlefield, triggering its own ability, returning Barren Glory to the battlefield.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, causing you to win the game.
